description: This file defines extension methods to configure placement directors within the Orleans Hosting framework. It provides methods to add and configure placement strategies and directors in dependency injection containers, supporting different lifetime scopes and creation delegates.

classes.name: PlacementStrategyExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to configure placement strategies and directors in Orleans hosting.

methods.name: AddPlacementDirector
methods.description: Configures a placement director for a specific strategy type, with options for default lifetime or custom lifetime, either via type parameters or delegate.
